standard.summary: 限制文本编码器的最大 token 数量。CLIP 原生限制 77 token；Lulynx 通过分段编码支持更长文本，max_token_length 控制上限。
standard.effect: SD1.5 默认 225（3×75 token）；SDXL 默认无额外限制。设太大会增加 TE 计算时间和显存。
standard.whenToUse: caption 较长（自然语言描述）时适当增大。使用短 tag 时默认值足够。
standard.avoidWhen: 不要设得比实际 caption 长度大太多——浪费显存。

standard_en.summary: Caps the text encoder's token count. CLIP's native limit is 77 tokens; Lulynx supports longer text through segmented encoding, and max_token_length sets the ceiling.
standard_en.effect: SD1.5 defaults to 225 (3x75 tokens); SDXL has no extra limit by default. Setting it too high adds TE compute time and VRAM.
standard_en.whenToUse: Raise it a little when captions are long (natural-language descriptions). The default is enough for short tags.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Do not set it far above your actual caption length -- that just wastes VRAM.

advanced.principle: CLIP 的单次前向最多处理 77 token（含 BOS/EOS）。Lulynx 将长文本分成多个 75-token chunk（不含 BOS/EOS），分别编码后拼接。max_token_length=225 表示最多 3 个 chunk。SDXL 使用两个 TE（CLIP-L + CLIP-G），拼接方式不同。
advanced.intervention: 在 tokenize 后截断到 max_token_length，然后分段 encode。
advanced.expectedImpact: 长 caption 场景下保留更多文本信息。对短 tag 无影响。
advanced.tradeoffs: enable_fixed_token_padding 强制 pad 到固定长度，配合 torch.compile 的 static shape 需求。

advanced_en.principle: CLIP's single forward processes at most 77 tokens (incl. BOS/EOS). Lulynx splits long text into multiple 75-token chunks (excluding BOS/EOS), encoding each and concatenating. max_token_length=225 means at most 3 chunks. SDXL uses two TEs (CLIP-L + CLIP-G) with a different concatenation.
advanced_en.intervention: Truncates to max_token_length after tokenization, then encodes in segments.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: Preserves more text information for long captions. No effect on short tags.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: enable_fixed_token_padding forces padding to a fixed length, meeting torch.compile's static-shape needs.
